description: This PHP class defines parameters for the 'GetUserPreferences' API call in SuiteCRM, extending a base parameter class and configuring options for user ID.

classes.name: GetUserPreferencesParams
classes.description: A class representing the parameters for retrieving user preferences, including a method to get the user ID and configuration of options.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID from the parameters array.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the parameter options, specifying that 'Id' is an acceptable parameter.
